violations.description: Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Pre-wash sink drain next to Dishwasher has a leak.
Toilet facilities. — --Both Toilet rooms were not provided with sufficient mechanical ventilation.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Remove old dirt from base boards.--Physical facilities Floor was not maintained in good repair. Several tiles missing or broke in kitchen area.
